note: tag mame0285, the release /usr/games/mame reports. sh2.cpp (interpreter + DRC front end), sh.cpp (instructions shared with SH-3/4), sh7604.cpp with sh7604_bus/sci/wdt: the on-die peripherals. No cache emulation: the data array mapping is commented out in sh7604.cpp. Emulator; detector for register state only (docs/validation.md).

SH2 interpreter + recompiler, sh7604/ (bus, cache, dma, interrupts, io, serial, timer). Cache refill reads the line in order 0,4,8,C and charges a flat 12 cycles (C4 in docs/undocumented-behavior.md). Emulator.

license: PicoDrive licence (COPYING): non-commercial; cpu/sh2/mame/ derives from MAME's old SH-2
note: irixxxx's fork, the maintained one (libretro builds from it; notaz/picodrive last moved 2025-04-03). cpu/sh2/mame/sh2.c is an old MAME interpreter, compiler.c the DRC; pico/32x/sh2soc.c the SH7604 peripherals as the 32X uses them. Emulator, speed-oriented.

Rust sh2-emu crate: CPU, cache, DMAC, DIVU, FRT, WDT, SCI. Its README: 'does not attempt to track timing. Almost all instructions take 1 cycle plus memory access delays'; issue #493 records the hardware-derived timing tweaks since. backend/s32x-core is NOT fetched (it carries SH-2 boot ROM binaries). Emulator.
Kronos (Yabause fork), default branch extui-align. Two interpreters (sh2_kronos, sh2_simple) and sys/sh2/sh2core.c. Emulator.
Upstream Yabause, last commit 2018: sh2int.c interpreter, sh2cache.c cache model, sh2core.c on-chip modules. Historical; Kronos continues it. Emulator.

Saturn emulator with a full SH7604 (BSC, cache, DIVU, DMAC, FRT, INTC, SCI, UBC, WDT, power). tests/.../sh2_divu_testdata.inc and sh2_macwl_testdata.inc: DIVU and MAC.W/MAC.L vectors whose origin the repository does not state. saturn.cpp 735-756: timings that 'pass misctest' left commented out. Emulator; the same commit Dunkley's note inspected.

srg320's SystemVerilog SH-2 core (rtl/SH/core) and SH7604 peripherals (rtl/SH/SH7604: BSC, CACHE, DIVU, DMAC, FRT, INTC, MULT, SCI, UBC, WDT), tuned against celeriyacon's non-public Saturn test programs; 'SH opcodes.xlsx' is its opcode/stage table. An FPGA reimplementation, not a die trace: emulator tier. The same commit Dunkley's note inspected.
The 32X copy of srg320's SH-2 RTL; it has diverged from the Saturn copy (CACHE.sv 20,952 vs 13,705 bytes). rtl/32X/ is NOT fetched: shbios.mif there is the 32X SH-2 boot ROM. Emulator tier.

SH2-on-the-32X.md (bakemono's and Chilly Willy's hardware throughput measurements, Sega TB #32 internal I/O access cycles), Bugs-and-quirks.md (the SH-2 '2.5 cut' interrupt bug, FRT bumping, Tom Forsyth on multiply overlap). Research documentation.

OPTIONAL (about 350 MB; --optional). SH-4 tests generated by Reicast's interpreter; no SH-2 corpus exists. One memory access per case, MACH/MACL excluded, no timing. Only the encodings the SH-2 shares are usable, as a weak detector of ALU and addressing semantics: emulator-derived, wrong CPU.
